title: ALP Workspace Settings
description: Native IDE and agent configuration for the workspace. Introduced in ALP v41.0.0 (IDE Productivity).

theme.description: UI theme preference for the native IDE.

default_agent.description: Default agent role used when none is specified.

trusted_paths.description: Glob patterns for paths that bypass policy enforcement.

excluded_paths.description: Glob patterns for paths excluded from workspace operations.
